items.summary: Mixture-of-Agents (MoA) methods combine the outputs of several large language models (LLMs) at inference time and have reported gains on conversational benchmarks. items.body: You can now measure realtime replies from the last detected user speech to first assistant playback when you configure local VAD. Read the latency from assistant message metrics: - **TLS**: contexts are cached per trust configuration; restart workers after replacing a CA bundle at the same path. - **Google**: instruction-free realtime replies are allowed on immutable-context models; unavailable timing is reported as unknown. Recording shutdown, VAD resizing, interruption teardown, chat summaries, structured outputs, multilingual sentence splitting, and tool discovery are more reliable.

items.body: - Added `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) notices a usage limit that was lifted before its reset - Fixed Workflow resume re-running already-completed `pipeline()` and `parallel()` agents instead of serving them from the run's journal - Fixed screen reader mode: search boxes now say "Search:" instead of a symbol VoiceOver read as "telephone recorder", and highlighted prompt text, such as Ctrl+R search matches and "ultrathink", no longer has spaces inside words - Self-hosted runner: Fixed a start script that shares only its stdout with the runner or orchestrator failing with `Resource temporarily unavailable` when `TERM` is set (a 2.1.300 regression)
